rules.statement: A partition decree made by a Court of Requests with reference to immovable property exceeding Rs. 300 in value is not binding on a person claiming an interest in the property who was not a party to the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "It may be taken therefore that, in view of the limitation of the Courts of Requests jurisdiction with respect to value, the decree in a partition action made by a Court of Requests affecting immovable property exceeding Rs. 300 in value is of no legal force."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 44 of the Evidence Ordinance, No. 14 of 1895; Section 2 of the Partition Ordinance, No. 10 of 1863.
